display.purpose: Hero name-mark only ('Sandra Novas'). Appears exactly once per page.

label.purpose: The two small uppercase eyebrow lines flanking the Hero name-mark.

headline.purpose: Every section title and route h1/h2/h3 outside the Hero, via Tailwind's font-serif utility. Gilda Display is loaded but not applied to this or any role — see The Loaded-Not-Live Rule.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, unlabeled, inherited from Tailwind Preflight.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default for cards, photos, and content blocks in normal document flow.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: Nav pill, modals, dropdown overlays, the Hero CTA bar, Instagram collage tiles — anything meant to feel detached from the page.

shadows.name: nav-ambient
shadows.purpose: The fixed nav pill's specific soft navy-tinted shadow, used nowhere else on the site.

shadows.name: text-legibility
shadows.purpose: Hero text over the video background only — a functional legibility aid, not a decorative elevation cue.

motion.name: hover-fade
motion.purpose: Default duration for color/opacity hover transitions across buttons and links.

motion.name: modal-fade
motion.purpose: Lightbox modal open/close opacity fade (all four modal implementations).

motion.name: slide-crossfade
motion.purpose: Crossfade between slides inside a lightbox modal.

motion.name: nav-idle-hide
motion.purpose: The floating nav pill fades out after 1s of no scroll/mouse activity and reappears instantly on input.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy-filled CTA — the default for standalone calls to action (e.g. 'SEGUIR NO INSTAGRAM').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #08284E; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0D3A6B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A96E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Gold-filled CTA — secondary actions inside content rows (e.g. 'SAIBA MAIS').
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #C9A96E; color: #08284E; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #B8956A; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08284E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Circular icon-only control used identically for close/prev/next across every lightbox modal. 44×44px minimum tap target.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost-icon" aria-label="Fechar"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M2 2l12 12M14 2L2 14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost-icon:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-btn-ghost-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Série Card
components.description: The default card: full-bleed cover image with a navy caption block anchored to one corner.
components.html:
SÉRIE MAR

2 OBRAS
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); background: #F9F2EC; width: 280px; } .ds-card-media { height: 220px; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6e88a8, #08284E); } .ds-card-caption { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; background: #08284E; padding: 12px 16px; border-top-right-radius: 16px; } .ds-card-title { color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-meta { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; margin: 0; }

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: The fixed, centered, frosted-glass nav pill. Idle-state links are Amber Ochre; hover goes white with a growing underline.
components.html: HOMEARTISTACOLEÇÕES
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 64px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(8,40,78,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(8,40,78,0.25); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #FBA13B; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: #fff; }

components.name: Slide Dot Indicator
components.description: The lightbox modal's position indicator. A large invisible padded hit area (44px-ish) wraps a small 6px visual dot so the control stays touch-friendly without inflating the visual rhythm of the dot row.
components.css: .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-dot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px; margin: -10px; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dot-visual { display: block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-dot--active .ds-dot-visual { width: 24px; background: #fff; } .ds-dot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like a private studio visit rather than a storefront: one long cream canvas, generous vertical breathing room, and a floating navy nav that fades from view the moment the visitor stops moving. Nothing competes for attention with the paintings themselves — chrome is deliberately quiet (a soft shadow-sm at rest, muted-gold accents used sparingly) so color and drama stay reserved for the artwork photography and the full-bleed hero video.

The palette does the emotional work: deep navy (#08284E) for anything that needs to feel grounded and permanent (nav, footer, card captions), antique gold (#C9A96E) for anything that should feel considered rather than loud, and warm linen (#F9F2EC) as the constant backdrop every section shares. Section titles are wrapped in an em dash on both sides ("— Explorar a coleção —"), a small, consistent editorial tic that reads as a catalogue label rather than a web-app heading.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous warm-linen canvas from the "Artista" section through the footer — sections are not visually alternated or boxed, they're one long room.
Deep navy is the anchor color for anything structural (nav, footer, card captions, primary CTAs); gold is reserved for accents, hover states, and secondary actions.
Flat by default; shadow appears only on floating chrome (nav pill, modals, the Hero CTA bar) to signal "this detaches from the page."
Uppercase, wide-tracked labels (tracking-[0.15em] to tracking-[0.4em]) are the default voice for anything that isn't a heading or body paragraph.

rules.name: The One-Gold Rule
rules.body: Antique Gold is the only accent color reused across unrelated components. When a new component needs an accent, reach for it before introducing a new hue — the palette stays coherent because gold never has to compete with a second accent.

rules.name: The Off-Palette Yellow/Blue Don't
rules.body: Two existing spots — the Hero primary CTA (bg-yellow-700/hover:bg-yellow-600, plus the bg-yellow-400 divider lines) and the "VER MAIS" badge in Colecao (bg-blue-700/50) — use Tailwind's stock yellow/blue scales instead of Antique Gold or Deep Harbor Navy. These are legacy one-offs, not a second accent family; don't extend them elsewhere.

rules.name: The Loaded-Not-Live Rule
rules.body: Gilda Display is imported via Google Fonts and declared in @theme as --font-gilda, but no component currently applies font-gilda. Every headline renders in the system serif stack via Tailwind's generic font-serif instead. Treat Gilda Display as reserved/available, not as the system's actual headline face, until a component is deliberately wired to it.

rules.name: The One-Display-Moment Rule
rules.body: Poppins Display appears exactly once per page (the Hero name-mark). Don't introduce a second Display-weight moment elsewhere — the rarity is what makes the Hero read as the page's single loud beat in an otherwise quiet system.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the normal document flow gets more than shadow-sm. A stronger shadow is a signal that the element floats above or outside the page's normal stacking — reserve it for that meaning.

dos: Do treat Deep Harbor Navy as the only structural/chrome color and Antique Gold as the only accent — see The One-Gold Rule.

Do keep new headlines in the system serif stack (font-serif) to match every existing section title, unless a deliberate decision is made to wire up Gilda Display sitewide (see The Loaded-Not-Live Rule) — don't apply Gilda Display to a single new component in isolation.
Do wrap new top-level section titles in the em-dash pattern ("— Title —") to match every existing section except the Artista intro.
Do give every icon-only control a real aria-label and a 44×44px minimum tap target — the established convention across all four lightbox modals and the nav hamburger.
Do keep new cards flat (shadow-sm) at rest and reserve stronger shadows for chrome that visually floats above the page (see The Flat-At-Rest Rule).
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue alongside Antique Gold. If a component needs more visual weight, use Deep Harbor Navy or increase scale/contrast rather than adding a new color family.

Don't replicate the Hero CTA's bg-yellow-700 or the "VER MAIS" badge's bg-blue-700/50 elsewhere — these are legacy Tailwind-stock-color one-offs outside the brand palette, not a sanctioned secondary accent (see The Off-Palette Yellow/Blue Don't).
Don't build a new full-screen image viewer from scratch — extend the existing Lightbox Modal convention (and its shared useFocusTrap hook) instead of writing a fifth implementation.
Don't assume Gilda Display governs anything just because it's loaded — verify a component actually applies font-gilda before treating it as live.
